title: Hermetica, Vol. 3
author: Walter Scott (ed)
description: A further volume in Walter Scott's edition of the Hermetic writings. It supports the study of texts attributed to Hermes Trismegistus and their philosophical, religious and interpretive background.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ScottHermeticaVolThree).
